podcast.body: "New Rose" by The Damned holds the distinction of being the first-ever punk rock single released in the UK. "Song called New Rose by the Damned."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: "New Rose" by The Damned was released on October 22nd, 1976, and holds the distinction of being the first punk rock single ever released in the UK. It was also the inaugural release from Stiff Records, which was dedicated to promoting DIY punk. "New Rose from the damned. The first punk rock single ever released in the UK, October 22nd, 1976."
